dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: There are many Ball Octopuses around. The Ball Octopuses here and Urville are very alike.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Well... Because they all tend to act tough to try to intimidate their opponents. And, that they all like to collect shiny treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: The Ball Octopuses might've hidden our stuff inside the shells...
